pages.text: This page catalogs various aquatic creatures in the overworld that can be summarized in a few sentences. Note that all mobs covered in this entry are untamable, with some even being outright hostile to players.

pages.title: Chub
pages.text: Passive, schooling fish found in regular and deep oceans.

pages.title: Gild Glider
pages.text: Passive, schooling fish found in warm and lukewarm oceans.

pages.title: Skib
pages.text: Benthic crustaceans found in regular and deep oceans that emit an explosive red energy.

pages.title: Spotted Striker
pages.text: Predatory sharks that patrol warm and lukewarm oceans. Their skin can turn invisible.

pages.title: Tearacuda
pages.text: Pack-hunting piscine that hunt schools of fish in regular and deep oceans. Flees from larger aquatic mobs
